# Introduction

## Research Question

Using performance metrics from earlier seasons, how accurately can models estimate player market values in a later season? How do observed valuations compare with these model estimates?

## Methodology Overview

This analysis employs multiple machine learning models to predict player market values:

1. **Linear Regression** - Baseline model for interpretability
2. **Elastic Net** - Regularized regression to handle multicollinearity
3. **Random Forest** - Ensemble tree-based method
4. **XGBoost** - Gradient boosting for optimal predictive performance

Models are selected using a calibration season and evaluated once on the latest season. The report includes RMSE, MAE, conventional R-squared, and a calibration-based prediction interval. The historical snapshots do not include valuation timestamps, so this is an out-of-time evaluation, not proof of a prospective forecast or market mispricing.

# Data Preprocessing

## Clean and Standardize Data

```{r clean-data}

merged <- prepared_data$joined

cat("After cleaning:\n")

```

## Data Quality Checks

```{r data-quality}

  knitr::kable(caption = "Source matching and ambiguity checks")
```

## Feature Engineering

```{r feature-engineering}
model_df <- merged %>%
  transmute(
    # Identifiers (not used in model)
    player_name = Player,
    season = season_start,
    league = league,
    
    # Target variable
    market_value = market_value_m,
    log_market_value = log1p(market_value_m),
    
    # Demographics
    # FBref age can be recorded as years-days (for example, "25-081").
    age = coalesce(player_age, parse_number(Age)),
    
    # Playing time
    minutes = Min_Playing,
    games = MP_Playing,
    starts = Starts_Playing,
    minutes_per_90 = Mins_Per_90_Playing,
    
    # Offensive stats
    goals = Gls,
    assists = Ast,
    goal_assists = `G+A`,
    non_pk_goals = G_minus_PK,
    penalties = PK,
    
    # Per 90 stats
    goals_per90 = Gls_Per,
    assists_per90 = Ast_Per,
    ga_per90 = `G+A_Per`,
    
    # Expected stats
    xg = xG_Expected,
    npxg = npxG_Expected,
    xag = xAG_Expected,
    xg_per90 = xG_Per,
    xag_per90 = xAG_Per,
    
    # Progression
    prog_carries = PrgC_Progression,
    prog_passes = PrgP_Progression,
    prog_receptions = PrgR_Progression,
    
    # Discipline
    yellow_cards = CrdY,
    red_cards = CrdR,
    
    # Position (simplified categories)
    position = case_when(
      str_detect(tolower(coalesce(player_position, Pos)), "goal|keeper|gk") ~ "GK",
      str_detect(tolower(coalesce(player_position, Pos)), "back|def|cb|lb|rb") ~ "DEF",
      str_detect(tolower(coalesce(player_position, Pos)), "mid|mf|dm|cm|am") ~ "MID",
      str_detect(tolower(coalesce(player_position, Pos)), "wing|forward|fw|st|cf") ~ "FWD",
      TRUE ~ "OTHER"
    )
  ) %>%
  # Create derived features
  mutate(
    # Performance over expectation
    goals_minus_xg = goals - coalesce(xg, 0),
    
    # Age categories
    age_group = cut(age, 
                    breaks = c(0, 21, 25, 29, 32, 50),
                    labels = c("Youth", "Emerging", "Peak", "Experienced", "Veteran")),
    
    # Starter ratio
    start_ratio = starts / pmax(games, 1),
    
    # Goal involvement rate
    goal_involvement = goal_assists / pmax(minutes_per_90, 1)
  ) %>%
  # Remove invalid observations
  filter(
    !is.na(market_value),
    !is.na(age),
    market_value > 0,
    position != "OTHER"
  )

cat("Final modeling dataset:", nrow(model_df), "observations\n")
cat("Features:", ncol(model_df), "columns\n")
```

## Define Time-Based Evaluation Periods

```{r evaluation-periods}
available_seasons <- sort(unique(model_df$season))
if (length(available_seasons) < 3) {
  stop("At least three seasons are required for train, calibration, and test sets.")
}

test_season <- max(available_seasons)
calibration_season <- available_seasons[length(available_seasons) - 1]
training_seasons <- available_seasons[available_seasons < calibration_season]
eda_df <- model_df %>% filter(season %in% training_seasons)

cat("Training seasons:", min(training_seasons), "to", max(training_seasons), "\n")
cat("Calibration season:", calibration_season, "\n")
cat("Held-out test season:", test_season, "\n")
```

# Model Preparation

## Prepare Feature Matrix

```{r prepare-features}
numeric_feature_names <- c(
  "age", "minutes", "games", "starts", "minutes_per_90",
  "goals", "assists", "goal_assists", "non_pk_goals",
  "goals_per90", "assists_per90", "ga_per90",
  "xg", "npxg", "xag", "xg_per90", "xag_per90",
  "prog_carries", "prog_passes", "prog_receptions",
  "yellow_cards", "red_cards", "goals_minus_xg",
  "start_ratio", "goal_involvement"
)

features <- model_df %>%
  transmute(
    player_name,
    season,
    log_market_value,
    market_value,
    across(all_of(numeric_feature_names)),
    position = factor(position, levels = c("GK", "DEF", "MID", "FWD")),
    league = factor(
      league,
      levels = c("Premier League", "La Liga", "Bundesliga", "Serie A", "Ligue 1")
    )
  )

if (anyNA(features$position) || anyNA(features$league)) {
  stop("Unexpected position or league category in model data.")
}

train_idx <- which(features$season < calibration_season)
calibration_idx <- which(features$season == calibration_season)
test_idx <- which(features$season == test_season)

train_features <- features[train_idx, ]
calibration_features <- features[calibration_idx, ]
test_features <- features[test_idx, ]

training_medians <- vapply(
  numeric_feature_names,
  function(column) median(train_features[[column]], na.rm = TRUE),
  numeric(1)
)
if (any(!is.finite(training_medians))) {
  stop("At least one numeric feature has no usable training values.")
}

impute_features <- function(data) {
  for (column in numeric_feature_names) {
    missing <- is.na(data[[column]])
    data[[paste0(column, "_missing")]] <- as.integer(missing)
    data[[column]][missing] <- training_medians[[column]]
  }
  data
}

train_features <- impute_features(train_features)
calibration_features <- impute_features(calibration_features)
test_features <- impute_features(test_features)

dummy_vars <- dummyVars(
  ~ position + league,
  data = train_features,
  fullRank = TRUE
)

make_feature_matrix <- function(data) {
  numeric_columns <- c(numeric_feature_names, paste0(numeric_feature_names, "_missing"))
  numeric_matrix <- data %>%
    select(all_of(numeric_columns)) %>%
    as.matrix()
  categorical_matrix <- predict(dummy_vars, newdata = data) %>%
    as.matrix()
  cbind(numeric_matrix, categorical_matrix)
}

X_train <- make_feature_matrix(train_features)
X_calibration <- make_feature_matrix(calibration_features)
X_test <- make_feature_matrix(test_features)
y_train <- train_features$log_market_value
y_calibration <- calibration_features$log_market_value
y_calibration_original <- calibration_features$market_value
y_test <- test_features$log_market_value
y_test_original <- test_features$market_value

cat("Training seasons:", min(train_features$season), "to", max(train_features$season), "\n")
cat("Calibration season:", calibration_season, "\n")
cat("Held-out test season:", test_season, "\n")
cat("Rows (train / calibration / test):",
    nrow(X_train), "/", nrow(X_calibration), "/", nrow(X_test), "\n")
cat("Features:", ncol(X_train), "\n")
```

## Time-Based Train, Calibration, and Test Split

```{r train-test-split}
cat("The latest season is reserved for final evaluation; it is not used for fitting or model selection.\n")
```

# Model Training

## Model 1: Linear Regression (Baseline)

```{r model-lm}
# Train linear regression
lm_data <- data.frame(y = y_train, X_train)
lm_model <- lm(y ~ ., data = lm_data)

# Model summary (key coefficients)
lm_summary <- summary(lm_model)
cat("Linear Regression R-squared:", round(lm_summary$r.squared, 4), "\n")
cat("Adjusted R-squared:", round(lm_summary$adj.r.squared, 4), "\n")

# Predictions
lm_pred_calibration <- predict(lm_model, newdata = data.frame(X_calibration))
lm_pred_test <- predict(lm_model, newdata = data.frame(X_test))
```

### Top Linear Regression Coefficients

```{r lm-coefficients}
coef_df <- data.frame(
  Variable = names(coef(lm_model))[-1],
  Coefficient = coef(lm_model)[-1]
) %>%
  mutate(Abs_Coef = abs(Coefficient)) %>%
  arrange(desc(Abs_Coef)) %>%
  head(15) %>%
  mutate(Coefficient = round(Coefficient, 4))

coef_df %>%
  select(Variable, Coefficient) %>%
  kable(caption = "Top 15 Linear Regression Coefficients (by magnitude)") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"))
```

## Model 2: Elastic Net (Regularized Regression)

```{r model-elasticnet}
# Cross-validation for optimal lambda
cv_glmnet <- cv.glmnet(X_train, y_train, alpha = 0.5, nfolds = 10)

cat("Optimal lambda:", round(cv_glmnet$lambda.min, 6), "\n")

# Fit final model
glmnet_model <- glmnet(X_train, y_train, alpha = 0.5, lambda = cv_glmnet$lambda.min)

# Predictions
glmnet_pred_calibration <- as.vector(predict(cv_glmnet, newx = X_calibration, s = "lambda.min"))
glmnet_pred_test <- as.vector(predict(glmnet_model, newx = X_test))
```

```{r elasticnet-cv-plot, fig.height=5}
plot(cv_glmnet, main = "Elastic Net Cross-Validation")
```

## Model 3: Random Forest

```{r model-rf}
# Train Random Forest
rf_model <- randomForest(
  x = X_train,
  y = y_train,
  ntree = 500,
  mtry = floor(sqrt(ncol(X_train))),
  importance = TRUE,
  nodesize = 5
)

# Predictions
rf_pred_calibration <- predict(rf_model, newdata = X_calibration)
rf_pred_test <- predict(rf_model, newdata = X_test)
```

### Random Forest Feature Importance

```{r rf-importance, fig.height=7}
rf_imp <- data.frame(
  Feature = rownames(importance(rf_model)),
  Importance = importance(rf_model)[, "%IncMSE"]
) %>%
  arrange(desc(Importance)) %>%
  head(20)

ggplot(rf_imp, aes(x = reorder(Feature, Importance), y = Importance)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "#27ae60", alpha = 0.8) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Random Forest Feature Importance",
    subtitle = "Top 20 features by % increase in MSE when permuted",
    x = "",
    y = "% Increase in MSE"
  )
```

## Model 4: XGBoost

```{r model-xgb}
# Create DMatrix objects
dtrain <- xgb.DMatrix(data = X_train, label = y_train)
dcalibration <- xgb.DMatrix(data = X_calibration, label = y_calibration)

# Parameters
xgb_params <- list(
  objective = "reg:squarederror",
  eta = 0.1,
  max_depth = 6,
  subsample = 0.8,
  colsample_bytree = 0.8
)

# Cross-validation for optimal rounds
xgb_cv <- xgb.cv(
  params = xgb_params,
  data = dtrain,
  nrounds = 500,
  nfold = 5,
  early_stopping_rounds = 20,
  print_every_n = 50,
  verbose = 0
)

# Use the evaluation log, which is available across XGBoost R versions.
best_rounds <- xgb_cv$evaluation_log$iter[
  which.min(xgb_cv$evaluation_log$test_rmse_mean)
]
cat("Optimal number of rounds:", best_rounds, "\n")

# Train final model
xgb_model <- xgb.train(
  params = xgb_params,
  data = dtrain,
  nrounds = best_rounds,
  watchlist = list(train = dtrain),
  print_every_n = 50,
  verbose = 0
)

# Predictions
xgb_pred_calibration <- predict(xgb_model, dcalibration)
xgb_pred_test <- predict(xgb_model, xgb.DMatrix(data = X_test))
```

### XGBoost Feature Importance

```{r xgb-importance, fig.height=7}
xgb_imp <- xgb.importance(feature_names = colnames(X_train), model = xgb_model)

xgb.ggplot.importance(head(xgb_imp, 20)) +
  labs(
    title = "XGBoost Feature Importance",
    subtitle = "Top 20 features by gain"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

# Model Comparison

## Performance Summary

```{r model-comparison}
model_predictions <- list(
  "Linear Regression" = list(calibration = lm_pred_calibration, test = lm_pred_test),
  "Elastic Net" = list(calibration = glmnet_pred_calibration, test = glmnet_pred_test),
  "Random Forest" = list(calibration = rf_pred_calibration, test = rf_pred_test),
  "XGBoost" = list(calibration = xgb_pred_calibration, test = xgb_pred_test)
)

comparison <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(names(model_predictions), function(model_name) {
  predictions <- model_predictions[[model_name]]
  smearing <- calculate_smearing_factor(y_calibration, predictions$calibration)
  calibration_log_metrics <- calculate_regression_metrics(y_calibration, predictions$calibration)
  calibration_euro_metrics <- calculate_regression_metrics(
    y_calibration_original,
    inverse_log_market_value(predictions$calibration, smearing)
  )
  test_log_metrics <- calculate_regression_metrics(y_test, predictions$test)
  test_euro_metrics <- calculate_regression_metrics(
    y_test_original,
    inverse_log_market_value(predictions$test, smearing)
  )

  data.frame(
    Model = model_name,
    Smearing_Factor = smearing,
    Calibration_RMSE_Log = calibration_log_metrics[["RMSE"]],
    Calibration_MAE_Log = calibration_log_metrics[["MAE"]],
    Calibration_R_squared_Log = calibration_log_metrics[["R_squared"]],
    Calibration_RMSE_EUR_M = calibration_euro_metrics[["RMSE"]],
    Calibration_MAE_EUR_M = calibration_euro_metrics[["MAE"]],
    Calibration_R_squared_EUR = calibration_euro_metrics[["R_squared"]],
    Test_RMSE_Log = test_log_metrics[["RMSE"]],
    Test_MAE_Log = test_log_metrics[["MAE"]],
    Test_R_squared_Log = test_log_metrics[["R_squared"]],
    Test_RMSE_EUR_M = test_euro_metrics[["RMSE"]],
    Test_MAE_EUR_M = test_euro_metrics[["MAE"]],
    Test_R_squared_EUR = test_euro_metrics[["R_squared"]]
  )
})) %>%
  arrange(Calibration_RMSE_Log)

selected_model <- comparison$Model[[1]]
selected_smearing_factor <- comparison$Smearing_Factor[[1]]
selected_predictions <- model_predictions[[selected_model]]

comparison %>%
  select(
    Model, Calibration_RMSE_Log, Test_RMSE_Log, Test_MAE_Log,
    Test_R_squared_Log, Test_RMSE_EUR_M, Test_MAE_EUR_M, Test_R_squared_EUR
  ) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(., 4))) %>%
  kable(caption = "Calibration-selected models and final latest-season performance") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover")) %>%
  row_spec(1, bold = TRUE, background = "#d4edda")
```

```{r comparison-plot, fig.height=5}
comparison_long <- comparison %>%
  select(Model, Test_RMSE_Log, Test_R_squared_Log) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(Test_RMSE_Log, Test_R_squared_Log),
               names_to = "Metric", values_to = "Value")

ggplot(comparison_long, aes(x = reorder(Model, -Value), y = Value, fill = Model)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", alpha = 0.8) +
  facet_wrap(~Metric, scales = "free_y") +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
  labs(
    title = "Model Performance Comparison",
    x = "",
    y = "Value"
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

# Model Valuation Gaps

## Calculate Residuals

The model is selected by calibration-season log RMSE. Gaps describe observed values relative to model estimates; they do not establish that a player is objectively over- or undervalued.

```{r residual-analysis}
interval_radius <- calculate_conformal_radius(
  y_calibration,
  selected_predictions$calibration,
  coverage = 0.9
)
test_log_prediction <- selected_predictions$test
predicted_value <- inverse_log_market_value(test_log_prediction, selected_smearing_factor)
interval_lower <- inverse_log_market_value(test_log_prediction - interval_radius)
interval_upper <- inverse_log_market_value(test_log_prediction + interval_radius)

residual_df <- model_df[test_idx, ] %>%
  select(player_name, season, age, position, league) %>%
  mutate(
    actual_value = y_test_original,
    predicted_value = predicted_value,
    prediction_lower_90 = interval_lower,
    prediction_upper_90 = interval_upper,
    valuation_gap = actual_value - predicted_value,
    valuation_gap_pct = (valuation_gap / pmax(predicted_value, 0.1)) * 100,
    gap_status = case_when(
      valuation_gap_pct > 25 ~ "Market above model",
      valuation_gap_pct < -25 ~ "Market below model",
      TRUE ~ "Within 25%"
    )
  )

interval_coverage <- mean(
  residual_df$actual_value >= residual_df$prediction_lower_90 &
    residual_df$actual_value <= residual_df$prediction_upper_90
)
cat("Selected model:", selected_model, "\n")
cat("Calibration season:", calibration_season, "\n")
cat("Held-out test season:", test_season, "\n")
cat("Nominal 90% interval coverage on test season:", round(interval_coverage * 100, 1), "%\n")

table(residual_df$gap_status) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rename(`Model Gap Category` = Var1, Count = Freq) %>%
  mutate(Percentage = round(Count / sum(Count) * 100, 1)) %>%
  kable() %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"))
```

## Actual vs Predicted Values

```{r actual-vs-predicted, fig.height=7}
ggplot(residual_df, aes(x = predicted_value, y = actual_value, color = gap_status)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5, size = 2) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", linewidth = 1) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = dollar_format(prefix = "€", suffix = "M")) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = dollar_format(prefix = "€", suffix = "M")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "Market above model" = "#e74c3c",
    "Market below model" = "#3498db",
    "Within 25%" = "#95a5a6"
  )) +
  labs(
    title = "Actual vs Predicted Market Value",
    subtitle = "Dashed line represents perfect prediction (actual = predicted)",
    x = "Predicted Market Value (Millions EUR)",
    y = "Actual Market Value (Millions EUR)",
    color = "Model gap"
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

# Model Gaps by Segment

## Position

```{r efficiency-position}
gap_by_position <- residual_df %>%
  group_by(position) %>%
  summarize(
    n = n(),
    mean_gap_pct = mean(valuation_gap_pct, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_gap_pct = median(valuation_gap_pct, na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_market_above = mean(gap_status == "Market above model") * 100,
    pct_market_below = mean(gap_status == "Market below model") * 100,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(., 2)))

gap_by_position %>%
  rename(
    Position = position,
    Count = n,
    `Mean gap (%)` = mean_gap_pct,
    `Median gap (%)` = median_gap_pct,
    `% market above model` = pct_market_above,
    `% market below model` = pct_market_below
  ) %>%
  kable(caption = "Observed-to-model gaps by position") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"))
```

# Conclusions

## Key Findings

```{r conclusions}
selected_test_metrics <- comparison %>%
  filter(Model == selected_model)

cat("1. MODEL PERFORMANCE\n")
cat("   - Selected on calibration season:", selected_model, "\n")
cat("   - Held-out test season:", test_season, "\n")
cat("   - Test RMSE: €", round(selected_test_metrics$Test_RMSE_EUR_M, 2), "M\n")
cat("   - Test MAE: €", round(selected_test_metrics$Test_MAE_EUR_M, 2), "M\n")
cat("   - Conventional test R-squared (euros):",
    round(selected_test_metrics$Test_R_squared_EUR, 4), "\n")
cat("   - Test coverage of nominal 90% interval:",
    round(interval_coverage * 100, 1), "%\n\n")

cat("2. KEY PREDICTORS OF MARKET VALUE\n")
cat("   - Age (non-linear relationship, peak at 24-28)\n")
cat("   - Goals and assists (strong positive correlation)\n")
cat("   - Expected goals (xG) metrics\n")
cat("   - Playing time (minutes, starts)\n")
cat("   - League (Premier League premium)\n\n")

cat("3. MODEL VALUATION GAPS\n")
cat("   -", round(mean(residual_df$gap_status == "Within 25%") * 100, 1),
    "% are within ±25% of the model estimate\n")
cat("   -", round(mean(residual_df$gap_status == "Market above model") * 100, 1),
    "% have observed values more than 25% above the model\n")
cat("   -", round(mean(residual_df$gap_status == "Market below model") * 100, 1),
    "% have observed values more than 25% below the model\n")
```

## Limitations and Future Work

1. **Data Limitations**: Transfermarkt market values are estimates, not actual transfer fees; the snapshots do not include valuation timestamps.
2. **Timing**: The season-level data cannot establish exactly when each valuation was observed, so the time-based holdout is not a guaranteed prospective forecast.
3. **Feature Availability**: Some advanced metrics (xG) are unavailable for earlier seasons and are imputed from training-season medians with missingness indicators.
4. **External Factors**: The model does not account for injury history, marketability, or contract situations.
5. **Future Directions**:
   - Include defensive metrics for defenders/goalkeepers
   - Add time-series analysis for value trajectories
   - Incorporate transfer fee data for validation
